ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-contrast profile dominated by mid-range gray values (approx. 30-50% intensity) with localized high-intensity peaks (80-90% intensity) corresponding to scarring, against a high-intensity atmospheric background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-gray base color across both lobes, overlaid with a dense network of thin, high-intensity linear streaks and scattered, high-contrast circular annular rings distributed across the mid and distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 72 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.15 relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 15 pixels, appearing more pronounced and irregular toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave sweep originating at the notch, transitioning to a broad convex curve across the central lobe, and terminating in a sharp upward-curving distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 12-15 distinct circular annular marks (rosette scars) ranging from 10 to 25 pixels in diameter, concentrated in the lower central and right-mid regions of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths and orientations, intersecting across approximately 75% of the visible ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive composite scarring including multi-directional rake marks and circular rosette patterns; visible tissue irregularities and micro-notches along the distal tips suggesting historic minor trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant atmospheric pixel diffusion (fog/mist) resulting in softened edge gradients between the fluke boundary and the background environment.
